text: Failed magician Corky Withers becomes a success once he adds [a foul-mouthed ventriloquist's dummy named Fats|images|dolls, masks and likenesses], a voice [he cannot control|origin|a mind turning on itself]. Dodging a network medical exam, he [returns to the Catskills where he grew up|trigger|going back home], where a card trick charms his high-school crush Peggy Ann, trapped in a passionless marriage to his old friend Duke. As jealousy rises in Duke and in Fats, [the dummy talks Corky into killing|threat|the enemy within] the agent who has discovered his secret.
